title: bug: Notes field not delivered to nightscout (at leats for carb correnctions)
symptom: When entering a note in the Notes field of the carbs dialog in AAPS 3.0.0.2, the note is not delivered to Nightscout; the treatment appears with an empty Notes column in Nightscout reports.
cause: The thread indicates that the notes field is not being sent to Nightscout in version 3.0.0.2, and a comment suggests that the database schema must be extended, implying the cause is a missing field in the data sent.
evidence_quote: Note: db schema must be extended
